name: SOS ~Shoujo ga Omorashi Shichattara~
original_name: S・O・S～しょうじょがおもらししちゃったら
source:
The main character meets a girl, Aki, on the train.  Aki has a problem with holding her bladder.

Aki's mother joins in and they have some fun...
